prompt:
Make a matching low-resolution PIXEL ART gaze atlas for the two commentators in the reference, keeping their exact friendly simplified v35 designs and clothing. Gerard LEFT, long clean-shaven face, thin round glasses, tousled brown hair, lemon/redflower Hawaiian shirt, blue headphones. Rene RIGHT silver hair, gray moustache, rectangular glasses, blue jacket/tie/headset. Same locked frontal camera, each person entirely inside his own HALF. Flat #081522 background. Desk horizontal at94%height. Large flat stable color clusters, tiny subdued warm whites of eyes, upper lids cover whites looking DOWN. No detailed wrinkles, no skin stipple. Faces remain sympathetic and mature.
Whole sheet exactly TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, eight equal LANDSCAPE duo cells aspect3:1, total1536x1024. NO labels gutters margins. Each cell same body, hands resting clasped, identical body/hair/face scale, ONLY mild head turn and eyes/mouth change. These are gazes toward points on the rink BELOW them, NOT looking sideways at each other, NOT at audience.
1 BOTH look DOWN-LEFT at the rink, mild 10-degree head turn, dark pupils low-left, closed mouths.
2 EXACT SAME as1, both mouths slightly open for speaking syllable, no head/body movement.
3 BOTH look DOWN-RIGHT at rink, mild10-degree head turn, pupils low-right, closed mouths.
4 EXACT SAME as3, only slightly open speaking mouths.
5 BOTH look DOWN-CENTER near front edge, chins slightly lowered, closed mouths.
6 EXACT SAME as5, only slightly open speaking mouths.
7 BOTH look farther DOWN-LEFT with slightly greater chin drop, mouths closed, still eyes open under lids.
8 BOTH look farther DOWN-RIGHT with slightly greater chin drop, mouths closed, still eyes open under lids.
Most important readable eye direction and small coherent head changes; do not close all eyes, do not turn to partner or look up. Preserve shared calm seated posture in every cell, no hands gestures.
